items.description: Retail electricity price for the modelled household (8,000 kWh a year, cheapest low-user plan without a fixed term), New Zealand row, 15 August 2026, including GST
items.note: Table row "New Zealand | New Zealand | 42.1 | 16.8 | 25.3" (retail, lines component, energy and other, c/kWh). The figure folds the plan's fixed daily charge into a price per kWh for the 22 kWh/day model household. Pukekohe (Counties Power), the estate's analogue, is 45.70 c/kWh.

items.description: Adjusted retail price of diesel in New Zealand, week of 16 October 2026, including GST
items.note: Table row "16 Oct 2026 | Diesel | 321.7" (NZ cents per litre). Prices rose from 187 c/L in February with the 2026 Middle East conflict, peaked at 381 c/L in April and stood at 267-322 c/L from August to October; the latest week is used.
